subject: Mobile Development
title: Before the App Store
description: One-minute skill: Before the App Store.

hook.text: Before 2008, installing software on a phone meant browsing shady WAP sites.

buildup.text: Nokia and Palm had software catalogs, but discovery was painful and installs often failed.

discovery.text: Java ME apps were cross-platform but limited. Carriers controlled what users could install.

twist.text: Carriers charged developers up to 50% revenue share just to list their apps.

climax.text: The mobile software market existed before Apple, but it was fragmented and hostile.

punchline.text: App stores didn't create mobile software. They fixed it.

quiz.question: Who controlled app distribution before app stores?
